shot.name: world-on-desk
shot.prompt: Photoreal cinematic miniature world, tactile ivory origami paper boat with one crisp triangular sail and sharply folded hull, no writing on the paper. Warm amber practical light against deep petrol-blue shadows, natural film contrast, 35mm commercial cinematography. The same single small ivory paper boat is the only hero object. A small ivory origami sailboat floats in a beautiful circular pool of deep blue ocean water on a dark wooden desk. The camera slowly pulls back from the boat and water to reveal that an entire miniature ocean world is contained on the desk beside a single blank sheet of paper. Strong amber side light, dark studio background. All geometry stable, realistic miniature water, no text or screens. One uninterrupted five-second shot.
